title: Wedge Antilles
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Wedge Antilles was a talented pilot from Corellia. After joining the Imperial Academy and attending the flight school at Skystrike Academy, he defected to the Rebel Alliance and fought in some of their most significant battles. He was Luke Skywalker's wing mate at the Battle of Yavin, fought AT-ATs on Hoth, and led the fighter assault against the second Death Star.
